2Diagramcode listingfunction [l,u]=trifactor(a,d,c) % [l,u]=trifactor(a,d,c) u=d; l=a; for k =1:length(a) l(k)=a(k)/u(k); u (k+1) = d(k+1) -l (k) *c(k) ; end Listing 2.1 trifactor
function [l,u]=trifactor(a,d,c)

% [l,u]=trifactor(a,d,c)

u=d; l=a;

for k =1:length(a)

    l(k)=a(k)/u(k);

    u (k+1) = d(k+1) -l (k) *c(k) ;

end

3Diagramcode listingfunction x = trisolve (l,u,c,b) % x = trisolve (l,u,c,b) x=b; n= size(b,1); for k =2:n x(k, :)=b(k, :) -l (k-1) *x(k-1, :) ; end x(n,:)=x(n,:)/u(n); for k=(n-1) :-1 :1 x(k, :) = (x(k, :) -c (k) *x(k+1, :) ) /u(k) ; end Listing 2.2 trisolve
function x = trisolve (l,u,c,b)

% x = trisolve (l,u,c,b)

x=b;

n= size(b,1);

for k =2:n

    x(k, :)=b(k, :) -l (k-1) *x(k-1, :) ;

end

x(n,:)=x(n,:)/u(n);

for k=(n-1) :-1 :1

    x(k, :) = (x(k, :) -c (k) *x(k+1, :) ) /u(k) ;

end

4Diagramcode listingfunction [x,C]=splineint(a,b,y,mu1,munp1) % [x,C]=splineint(a,b,y,mul,munp1) y=y(:); n=length(y)-1; h=(b-a)/n; x=a:h:b-h; c=ones(n-2,1); [l,u]= trifactor(c,4*ones(n-1,1),c); b1=6/h^2*(y(3:n+1)-2*y(2:n)+y(1:n-1)); b1(1)=b1(1)-mu1; b1(n-1)=b1(n-1)-munp1; mu= [mu1;trisolve(l,u,c,b1);munp1]; C=zeros(4*n,1); C(1:4:4*n-3)=y(1:n); C(2:4:4*n-2)=(y(2:n+1)-y(1:n))/h... -h*mu(1:n)/3-h*mu(2:n+1
function [x,C]=splineint(a,b,y,mu1,munp1)

% [x,C]=splineint(a,b,y,mul,munp1)

y=y(:); n=length(y)-1;

h=(b-a)/n; x=a:h:b-h; c=ones(n-2,1);

[l,u]= trifactor(c,4*ones(n-1,1),c);

b1=6/h^2*(y(3:n+1)-2*y(2:n)+y(1:n-1));

b1(1)=b1(1)-mu1; b1(n-1)=b1(n-1)-munp1;

mu= [mu1;trisolve(l,u,c,b1);munp1];

C=zeros(4*n,1);

C(1:4:4*n-3)=y(1:n);

C(2:4:4*n-2)=(y(2:n+1)-y(1:n))/h...

    -h*mu(1:n)/3-h*mu(2:n+1)/6;

C(3:4:4*n-1)=mu(1:n)/2;

C(4:4:4*n)=(mu(2:n+1)-mu(1:n))/(6*h);

C=reshape (C,4,n) ';

end

5Diagramcode listingfunction i = findsubintervals(t,x) %i = findsubintervals(t,x) k=length(t); m=length(x); if k<2 i=ones (m,1) ; else t (1) = min (x (1) , t (1) ) - 1; [~,j]=sort([t(:)',x(:)']); i=(find(j>k)-(1:m))'; end Listing 2.4 findsubintervals
function i = findsubintervals(t,x)

%i = findsubintervals(t,x)

k=length(t); m=length(x);

    if k<2

        i=ones (m,1) ;

    else

        t (1) = min (x (1) , t (1) ) - 1;

        [~,j]=sort([t(:)',x(:)']);

        i=(find(j>k)-(1:m))';

    end

6Diagramcode listingfunction [X,G]=splineval(x,C,X) % [X,G]=splineval(x,C,X) m=length(X); i=findsubintervals(x,X); G=zeros(m,1); for j=1:m k=i(j); t=X(j)-x(k); G(j)=[1,t,t^2,t^3]*C(k,:)'; end Listing 2.5 splineval
function [X,G]=splineval(x,C,X)

% [X,G]=splineval(x,C,X)

m=length(X);

i=findsubintervals(x,X);

G=zeros(m,1);

for j=1:m

        k=i(j);

        t=X(j)-x(k);

    G(j)=[1,t,t^2,t^3]*C(k,:)';

end

8Diagramcode listingfunction x=rforwardsolve (A,b,d) % x=rforwardsolve(A,b,d) n=length(b); x=b; x (1) =b(1) /A(1,1); for k=2:n lk=max(1,k-d); x(k)=(b(k)-A(k,lk:(k-1))*x(lk:(k-1)))/A(k,k); end Listing 3.1 rforwardsolve
function x=rforwardsolve (A,b,d)

% x=rforwardsolve(A,b,d)

n=length(b); x=b;

x (1) =b(1) /A(1,1);

for k=2:n

    lk=max(1,k-d);

    x(k)=(b(k)-A(k,lk:(k-1))*x(lk:(k-1)))/A(k,k);

end

9Diagramcode listingfunction x=rbacksolve (A,b,d) % x=rbacksolve(A,b,d) n=length(b); x=b; x (n) =b(n) /A(n,n) ; for k=n-1:-1:1 uk=min(n,k+d); x (k) = (b(k) -A(k, (k+1) :uk) *x((k+1) :uk)) /A(k,k); end Listing 3.2 rbacksolve
function x=rbacksolve (A,b,d)

% x=rbacksolve(A,b,d)

n=length(b); x=b;

x (n) =b(n) /A(n,n) ;

for k=n-1:-1:1

    uk=min(n,k+d);

    x (k) = (b(k) -A(k, (k+1) :uk) *x((k+1) :uk)) /A(k,k);

end

10Diagramcode listingfunction x=cforwardsolve(A,b,d) %x=cforwardsolve(A,b,d) x=b; n=length(b); for k=1:n-1 x (k) = b (k) /A (k,k) ; uk=min (n,k+d) ; b((k+1):uk)=b((k+1):uk)-A((k+1):uk,k)*x(k); end x (n) = b (n) /A(n,n) ; end Listing 3.3 cforwardsolve
function x=cforwardsolve(A,b,d)

%x=cforwardsolve(A,b,d)

x=b; n=length(b);

for k=1:n-1

    x (k) = b (k) /A (k,k) ; uk=min (n,k+d) ;

    b((k+1):uk)=b((k+1):uk)-A((k+1):uk,k)*x(k);

end

x (n) = b (n) /A(n,n) ;

end

function [L,U]=L1U(A,d)

% [L,U]=L1U(A,d)

n=length(A);

L=eye(n,n); U=zeros(n,n);U(1,1)=A(1,1);

for k=2:n

    km=max(1,k-d);

    L (k,km:(k-1) )=rforwardsolve(U(km:(k-1) ...

    ,km:(k-1))',A(k,km:(k-1))',d)';

    U(km:k,k)=rforwardsolve(L(km:k,km:k),A(km:k,k),d);

function x=cbacksolve (A,b,d)

% x=cbacksolve(A,b,d)

x=b; n=length(b);

for k=n:-1:2

    x (k) =b(k) /A(k,k); lk=max(1,k-d) ;

end

function [L,dg]=LDLs(A,d)

% [L,dg]=LDLs(A,d)

n=length(A);

L=eye(n,n); dg=zeros(n,1);dg(1)=A(1,1);

for k=2:n

    m=rforwardsolve(L(1:k-1,1:k-1),A(1:k-1,k),d);

    L (k,1:k-1)=m./dg(1:k-1);

    dg(k)=A(k,k)-L(k,1:k-1)*m;

end

function L=bandsemicholeskyL(A,d)

%L=bandsemicholeskyL (A,d)

n=length(A);

for k=1:n

    kp=min(n,k+d);

    if A(k,k) >0

        A(k,k)=sqrt(A(k,k));

        A((k+1):kp,k)=A((k+1):kp,k)/A(k,k);

            for j=k+1:kp

                A(j:kp,j)=A(j:kp,j)-A(j,k)*A(j:kp,k);

19Diagramcode listingfunction [u,a]=housegen(x) % [u,a]=housegen (x) a=norm(x); if a==0 u=x; u(1)=sqrt(2); return; end if x(1)== 0 r=1; else r=x(1)/abs(x(1)); end u=conj (r) *x/a; u(1) =u(1) +1; u=u/sqrt(u(1)); a=-r*a; end Listing 5.1 housegen
function [u,a]=housegen(x)

% [u,a]=housegen (x)

a=norm(x);

if a==0

    u=x; u(1)=sqrt(2); return;

end

if x(1)== 0

    r=1;

else

    r=x(1)/abs(x(1));

end

u=conj (r) *x/a;

u(1) =u(1) +1;

u=u/sqrt(u(1));

a=-r*a;

end

20Diagramcode listingfunction [R, C] = housetriang(A,B) % [R,C] = housetriang(A,B) [m,n]=size(A); r=size(B,2); A=[A,B]; for k=1:min(n,m-1) [v,A(k,k)]=housegen(A(k:m,k)); C=A(k:m,k+1:n+r); A(k:m,k+1:n+r)=C-v*(v'*C); end R=triu(A(:,1:n)); C=A(:,n+1:n+r); end Listing 5.2 housetriang
function [R, C] = housetriang(A,B)

% [R,C] = housetriang(A,B)

[m,n]=size(A); r=size(B,2); A=[A,B];

for k=1:min(n,m-1)

    [v,A(k,k)]=housegen(A(k:m,k));

    C=A(k:m,k+1:n+r); A(k:m,k+1:n+r)=C-v*(v'*C);

end

R=triu(A(:,1:n)); C=A(:,n+1:n+r);

end

22Diagramcode listingfunction x=rothesstri(A,b) % x=rothesstri(A,b) n=length(A);A=[A b]; for k=1:n-1 r=norm([A(k,k),A(k+1,k)]); if r>0 c=A(k,k)/r; s=A(k+1,k)/r; A([k k+1],k+1:n+1) ... =[c s;-s c]*A([k k+1],k+1:n+1); end A(k,k)=r; A(k+1,k)=0; end x=rbacksolve(A(:,1:n),A(:,n+1),n); end Listing 5.3 rothesstri
function x=rothesstri(A,b)

% x=rothesstri(A,b)

n=length(A);A=[A b];

for k=1:n-1

    r=norm([A(k,k),A(k+1,k)]);

    if r>0

        c=A(k,k)/r; s=A(k+1,k)/r;

        A([k k+1],k+1:n+1) ...

            =[c s;-s c]*A([k k+1],k+1:n+1);

    end

    A(k,k)=r; A(k+1,k)=0;

end

x=rbacksolve(A(:,1:n),A(:,n+1),n);

end

28Diagramcode listingfunction V=fastpoisson(F) %function V=fastpoisson (F) m=length(F); h=1/(m+1); hv=pi*h*(1:m)'; sigma=sin(hv/2).^2; S=sin(hv*(1:m)); G=S*F*S; X=h^4*G./(sigma*ones(1,m)+ ones(m,1)*sigma′); V=zeros (m+2,m+2) ; V(2:m+1,2:m+1)=S*X*S; end Listing 11.1 fastpoisson
function V=fastpoisson(F)

%function V=fastpoisson (F)

m=length(F); h=1/(m+1); hv=pi*h*(1:m)';

sigma=sin(hv/2).^2;

S=sin(hv*(1:m));

G=S*F*S;

X=h^4*G./(sigma*ones(1,m)+ ones(m,1)*sigma′);

V=zeros (m+2,m+2) ;

V(2:m+1,2:m+1)=S*X*S;

end

function z=fftrec(y)

%function z=fftrec(y)

y=y(:);

n=length(y);

if n==1

    z=y;

else

    q2=exp(-2*pi*1i/n).^(0:n/2-1)'.*fftrec(y(2:2:n));

end

31Diagramcode listingfunction k=jdp(F,K,tol) % k=jdp(F,K,tol) m=length(F); U=fastpoisson(F); V=zeros (m+2,m+2) ; E=F/(m+1) ^2; for k=1:K V(2:m+1,2:m+1)=(V(1:m,2:m+1)+V(3:m+2,2:m+1)... +V(2:m+1,1:m)+V(2:m+1,3:m+2)+E)/4; if max(max(abs(V-U)))<tol, return end end k=K+1; end Listing 12.1 jdp
function k=jdp(F,K,tol)

% k=jdp(F,K,tol)

m=length(F); U=fastpoisson(F);

V=zeros (m+2,m+2) ; E=F/(m+1) ^2;

for k=1:K

    V(2:m+1,2:m+1)=(V(1:m,2:m+1)+V(3:m+2,2:m+1)...

        +V(2:m+1,1:m)+V(2:m+1,3:m+2)+E)/4;

    if max(max(abs(V-U)))<tol, return

    end

end

k=K+1;

end

32Diagramcode listingfunction k=sordp(F,K,w,tol) % k=sordp(F,K,w,tol) m=length(F); U=fastpoisson(F); V=zeros(m+2,m+2); E=F/(m+1)^2; for k=1:k for j=2:m+1 for i=2:m+1 V(i,j)=w*(V(i-1,j)+V(i+1,j)+V(i,j-1)... +V(i,j+1)+E(i-1,j-1))/4+(1-w)*V(i,j); end end if max(max(abs(V-U)))<tol, return end end k=K+1; end Listing 12.2 sordp
function k=sordp(F,K,w,tol)

% k=sordp(F,K,w,tol)

m=length(F); U=fastpoisson(F); V=zeros(m+2,m+2); E=F/(m+1)^2;

for k=1:k

    for j=2:m+1

        for i=2:m+1

            V(i,j)=w*(V(i-1,j)+V(i+1,j)+V(i,j-1)...

                +V(i,j+1)+E(i-1,j-1))/4+(1-w)*V(i,j);

        end

    end

    if max(max(abs(V-U)))<tol, return

    end

end

k=K+1;

end

35Diagramcode listingfunction [x,K]=cg(A,b,x,tol,itmax) % [x,K]=cg(A,b,x,tol,itmax) r=b-A*x; p=r; rho0=b'*b; rho=r'*r; for k=0:itmax if sqrt(rho/rho0)<= tol K=k; return end t=A*p; a=rho/(p’*t); x=x+a*p; r=r-a*t; rhos=rho; rho=r'*r; p=r+(rho/rhos)*p; end K=itmax+1; end Listing 13.1 cg
function [x,K]=cg(A,b,x,tol,itmax)

% [x,K]=cg(A,b,x,tol,itmax)

r=b-A*x; p=r; rho0=b'*b; rho=r'*r;

for k=0:itmax

    if sqrt(rho/rho0)<= tol

        K=k; return

    end

    t=A*p; a=rho/(p’*t);

    x=x+a*p; r=r-a*t;

end

36Diagramcode listingfunction [V,K]=cgtest(m,a,d,tol,itmax) % [V,K]=cgtest(m,a,d,tol,itmax) R=ones (m) / (m+1) ^2; rho=sum(sum(R.*R)) ; rho0=rho; P=R; V=zeros(m,m); Tl=sparse(tridiagonal(a,d,a,m)); for k=1:itmax if sqrt(rho/rho0)<= tol K=k; return end T=T1*P+P*T1; a=rho/sum(sum(P.*T)); V=V+a*P; R=R-a*T; rhos=rho; rho=sum(sum(R.*R)); P=R+(rho/rhos)*P; end K=itmax+1; end Listing
function [V,K]=cgtest(m,a,d,tol,itmax)

% [V,K]=cgtest(m,a,d,tol,itmax)

R=ones (m) / (m+1) ^2; rho=sum(sum(R.*R)) ; rho0=rho; P=R;

V=zeros(m,m); Tl=sparse(tridiagonal(a,d,a,m));

for k=1:itmax

    if sqrt(rho/rho0)<= tol

        K=k; return

    end

    T=T1*P+P*T1;

    a=rho/sum(sum(P.*T)); V=V+a*P; R=R-a*T;

    rhos=rho; rho=sum(sum(R.*R)); P=R+(rho/rhos)*P;

end

K=itmax+1;

end

40Diagramcode listingfunction [L,B] = hesshousegen(A) n=length(A); L=zeros(n,n); B=A; for k=1:n-2 [v,B(k+1,k)]=housegen(B(k+1:n,k)); L((k+1):n,k)=v; B((k+2):n,k)=zeros(n-k-1,1); C=B((k+1):n, (k+1):n); B ( (k+1) :n, (k+1) :n) =C-v* (v'*C) ; C=B(1:n, (k+1):n); B(1:n, (k+1):n)=C-(C*v)*v'; end end Listing 14.1 hesshousegen
function [L,B] = hesshousegen(A)

n=length(A); L=zeros(n,n); B=A;

for k=1:n-2

    [v,B(k+1,k)]=housegen(B(k+1:n,k));

    L((k+1):n,k)=v; B((k+2):n,k)=zeros(n-k-1,1);

    C=B((k+1):n, (k+1):n);

    B ( (k+1) :n, (k+1) :n) =C-v* (v'*C) ;

    C=B(1:n, (k+1):n); B(1:n, (k+1):n)=C-(C*v)*v';

end

end

43Diagramcode listingfunction [l,x,it]=powerit(A,z,K,tol) % [l,x,it]=powerit(A,z,K,tol) af=norm(A,'fro'); x=z/norm(z); for k=1:K y=A*x; l=x'*y; if norm(y-l*x)/af<tol it=k; x=y/norm(y); return end x=y/norm(y); end it=K+1; end Listing 15.1 powerit
function [l,x,it]=powerit(A,z,K,tol)

% [l,x,it]=powerit(A,z,K,tol)

af=norm(A,'fro'); x=z/norm(z);

for k=1:K

    y=A*x; l=x'*y;

44Diagramcode listingfunction [x,s,nr]=rayleighit(A,x,s) % [x,s,nr]=rayleighit(A,x,s) n=length(x); y=(A-s*eye(n,n))\x; yn=norm(y); w=x/yn; x=y/yn; rho=x'*w; s=s+rho; nr=norm(w-rho*x); end Listing 15.2 rayleighit
function [x,s,nr]=rayleighit(A,x,s)

% [x,s,nr]=rayleighit(A,x,s)
